rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f1040s3 line 2: "Credit for child and dependent care expenses from Form 2441, line 11. Attach Form 2441", and i2441 p. 1, Purpose of Form: "If you paid someone to care for your child or other qualifying person so you (or your spouse if filing jointly) could work or look for work in 2025, you may be able to take the credit". A filer with no care expenses takes no credit and needs no Form 2441 Part II; the project guards on f2441.care. The candidate copies f2441.line11 on every return. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/s3.json; 1,222 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 120 partial records): 391 of 1,842 agree; 697 candidate-unknown (344 on completed returns: classm.f8995.2, classm.f8995.3, classm.ltc.1, project $0.00, candidate stops on the care-provider roster), 754 candidate-refuses (749 on refused returns: classm.w2.1.deepseek, classm.g28.2.deepseek, classm.clcw.1.deepseek; 2 completed and 3 incomplete, gates reached only because Form 2441 is evaluated with no care); no value differs. The interface offers f2441.care: not an interface gap. As ruled before Stage 18. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f1040s3 line 5a, "Residential clean energy credit from Form 5695, line 15", and i5695 p. 1, Who Can Take the Credits: "You may be able to take the credits if you made energy saving improvements to your home located in the United States in 2025". The project guards on f5695.part1_any; the candidate copies f5695.line15 on every return. Triage (triage/s3.json, as on line 2): 288 of 1,842 agree; 751 candidate-unknown (403 completed: f5695.business_use asked of filers with no property, classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek, project $0.00), 803 candidate-refuses (798 refused returns, classm.w2.1.deepseek, classm.g28.2.deepseek); no value differs. The interface offers f5695.part1_any: not an interface gap. As ruled before Stage 18. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 117, Line 9: "Complete Form 8962 to determine the amount of your premium tax credit, if any. If the premium tax credit you can claim exceeds your advance credit payments, your net premium tax credit will be shown on Form 8962, line 26. Enter that amount, if any, on line 9". The project enters zero when no Form 1095-A is listed (f8962.any false, i8962 p. 3, Who Must File); the candidate copies the Form 8962 line on every return, so a filer with no Marketplace coverage must answer Form 8962's questions (f8962.alloc, f8962.fpl_table, each dependent's ptc_files) and reach its household income. Triage (triage/s3.json): 488 of 1,842 agree; 1,111 candidate-unknown (442 on completed returns, project $0.00), 243 candidate-refuses, all on refused returns (classm.dependent.1, .2 and .5 and their deepseek twins); no value differs. The interface offers f8962.any: not an interface gap. Project stands.
